broadcasts.message: normalize.js final for round 4. Meets all requirements: NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to one ASCII space, trim. Does not add, drop, replace, or reorder words. Handles non-string safely. Ready for final integration.

tokenizer.js final version: calls injected normalize(text) once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex, preserves input order, no stopwords, negation words preserved. No changes across rounds. Ready for final integration.
Pipeline final and unchanged. Uses Object.create(null) for prototype-safe frequencies, returns exact contract. All modules integrated.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 final: normalize.js is complete and unchanged. It implements NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single ASCII space, and trim. Non-string inputs return empty string for robustness. No shadowing of injected dependencies. All modules are consistent and faithful. No further changes needed.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 4 final: tokenizer.js is complete and correct. It calls injected normalize(text) once, then uses regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g to extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order. No stopwords, negation preserved. No changes needed. Collaboration complete.
private_memories.integrator: Round 4 (final): All modules stable and matching spec. My pipeline.js is final. It calls tokenize once, uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to safely handle prototype names, and returns exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. No changes needed. Final code submitted.
